no_adcom_quote.quote: We have not presented ambrisentan at an advisory committee meeting nor do we plan to present it.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for Letairis (ambrisentan, NDA022081). The Medical Review states under its Advisory Committee Meeting section that the drug was not presented to an advisory committee and no such presentation was planned, and the administrative file documents no AC meeting. Because no committee met, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval; safety concerns (teratogenicity, hepatotoxicity) were instead managed through a closed-distribution postmarketing risk management plan handled in review and labeling negotiations.
